title: AQLProfile SPM packet golden dump
description: Schema for deterministic aqlprofile_spm_create_packets dumps and per-architecture SPM configuration queries. Runtime SPM collection (aqlprofile_spm_start/stop) and stream decoding are not captured.

uint32_hex.description: A zero-padded 32-bit unsigned value rendered as lowercase hexadecimal.

uint64_hex.description: A zero-padded 64-bit unsigned value rendered as lowercase hexadecimal.

offset_hex.description: A byte offset rendered as lowercase hexadecimal without a fixed width.

harness_environment.description: Environment variables set by the harness that change AQLProfile SPM behavior.

AQLPROFILE_SPM_OVERRIDE_AGENT_CHECK.description: Value seen by AQLProfile. A non-zero value bypasses the gfx90a and host SR-IOV agent checks so host state cannot change the result; null means the variable was unset.

spm_harness.description: Harness conditions under which every case in the document was generated.

configurations_harness.description: Harness conditions under which the configuration query ran.

name.description: Semantic counter-block name used by config.yaml and the block query.

__implementation_aqlprofile:block_id.description: Legacy AQLProfile block enum value. This is diagnostic implementation metadata and need not match a Rust implementation.

instance_count.description: Block instance count returned by the block query; per-instance cases use block_index 0 through instance_count - 1.

event_definition.description: Basic event from config.yaml for which aqlprofile_spm_is_event_supported returned true.

name.description: Stable symbolic event name used by requests in this dump.

event_id.description: Architecture-specific hardware event selector from config.yaml.

skipped_event.description: Basic event from config.yaml that has no packet cases in this dump.

event_id.description: Architecture-specific hardware event selector from config.yaml.

reason.description: metric_name_contains_level_token: skipped by the config export's name-based level-counter heuristic. aqlprofile_spm_is_event_supported_returned_false: direct API observation for block_index 0 with zero flags.

event.description: Reference to an entry in the root events array by symbolic name.

block_index.description: Exact AQLProfile block_index request field selecting one physical block instance.

flags.description: Exact event flags passed to AQLProfile. Zero requests the default SPM depth.

request_parameter.description: One aqlprofile_spm_parameter_t passed in aqlprofile_spm_profile_t.parameters, in array order.

value.description: Raw parameter value: bytes for BUFFER_SIZE, clock cycles for SAMPLE_INTERVAL, milliseconds for TIMEOUT, and an aqlprofile_spm_parameter_interval_mode_t value for SAMPLE_MODE.

allocation_flags.description: Decoded aqlprofile_buffer_desc_flags_t supplied to the allocation callback.

host_access.description: Whether AQLProfile requested host access to the allocation.

device_access.description: Whether AQLProfile requested device access to the allocation.

allocation.description: One memory allocation requested while creating the SPM packets.

id.description: Allocation role inferred from use: command receives the PM4 copies, and output is every other allocation. The descriptor lies inside an output allocation.

observed_call_index.description: Zero-based observed allocation-callback order. This is legacy behavior, not necessarily a required ordering.

base.description: Deterministic virtual address returned by the fixture allocator.

size_bytes.description: Minimum byte size requested through the allocation callback.

flags.description: Access and memory-hint flags supplied with the request.

memory_copy.description: One memcpy callback used by AQLProfile to place a phase's PM4 IB into command memory.

observed_call_index.description: Zero-based observed memcpy-callback order. This is informative rather than normative.

phase.description: Packet phase identified by matching the copy destination to the returned AQL IB target.

destination.description: Symbolic copy destination inside a captured allocation.

allocation.description: Allocation receiving the copied PM4 stream.

offset_bytes.description: Byte offset from the command allocation base.

size_bytes.description: Actual unpadded number of PM4 bytes copied.

aql_packet.description: Raw 64-byte outer AQL packet containing an INDIRECT_BUFFER command for one phase.

ib_target.description: Symbolic address and placement metadata for the PM4 indirect buffer.

base.description: Symbolic allocation base used by the target address.

offset_bytes.description: Byte offset from command_base encoded in the INDIRECT_BUFFER packet.

align_bytes.description: Command-section alignment returned by CommandBufferMgr::Align(1); generation fails if the base or IB target violates it.

ib_bytes.description: PM4 indirect-buffer size encoded by the AQL wrapper.

uint32_t.description: All 16 raw little-endian AQL dwords as padded hexadecimal strings.

pm4_ib.description: Raw PM4 indirect-buffer payload copied into command memory for one phase.

uint32_t.description: Raw little-endian PM4 dwords in legacy emission order.

pm4_ib.$comment: The uint32_t element count multiplied by four must equal size_bytes.

aql_packet_reference.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer to the identical START AQL packet of an earlier case with the same block indices.

phase.description: Outer AQL packet and referenced PM4 IB for the START or STOP phase.

descriptor.description: Raw bytes that the data pointer of the aqlprofile_spm_buffer_desc_t returned by create points to (size bytes), read before delete. Decoders treat the contents as opaque and access them through aqlprofile_spm_decode_query and aqlprofile_spm_decode_stream_v1.

offset_bytes.description: Byte offset of desc.data from output_base.

uint32_t.description: All desc.size bytes as raw little-endian dwords. Bytes AQLProfile did not write keep the fixture allocator's zero fill.

descriptor.$comment: The uint32_t element count multiplied by four must equal size_bytes.

decode_queries.description: Results of aqlprofile_spm_decode_query on the returned descriptor, keyed by aqlprofile_spm_decode_query_t name.

AQLPROFILE_SPM_DECODE_QUERY_SEG_SIZE.description: Byte size of one SPM sample segment, computed from the line counts recorded in the descriptor.

AQLPROFILE_SPM_DECODE_QUERY_NUM_XCC.description: Number of XCCs recorded in the descriptor.

AQLPROFILE_SPM_DECODE_QUERY_EVENT_COUNT.description: Number of request events recorded in the descriptor.

AQLPROFILE_SPM_DECODE_QUERY_COUNTER_MAP_.description: Byte offset of the counter map from the start of the descriptor bytes.

allocations_reference.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer to an identical allocation transcript of an earlier case with the same block indices.

memory_copies_reference.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer to an identical memory-copy transcript of an earlier case with the same block indices.

stop_reference.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer to an identical STOP phase of an earlier case with the same block indices.

descriptor_reference.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer to an identical descriptor of an earlier case with the same block indices.

decode_queries_reference.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer to identical decode-query results of an earlier case with the same block indices.

response.description: All captured outputs and callback observations from one successful aqlprofile_spm_create_packets call. References are emitted only after the harness asserted equality with the referenced case.

allocations.description: Output and command allocations requested by AQLProfile.

memory_copies.description: Observed PM4 stream copies into the command allocation.

descriptor.description: Descriptor returned for decoding streamed data.

decode_queries.description: Public decode-query results for the descriptor.

spm_case.description: One independent aqlprofile_spm_create_packets request and captured response.

request.description: Exact event and parameter inputs for this call. Creation flags and profile.reserved are zero.

shape.description: Structural request shape derived directly from the number and arrangement of request entries.

events.description: Events supplied together in this SPM profile, in array order.

parameters.description: Parameters supplied in this SPM profile, in array order.

spm_dump.description: Per-instance and combined all-instance SPM packet-creation cases for one block on one topology.

format_version.description: Linear packet-dump format version for compatibility checks.

gfx.description: GPU architecture name used to register the agent.

topology.description: Relative path of the agent and IP-discovery fixture document for this architecture.

configurations.description: Relative path of this architecture's SPM configuration-query document.

events.description: Basic event catalog referenced by the cases in spm.

skipped.description: Basic events from config.yaml that have no cases, ordered by event_id.

byte_order.description: Byte order used when interpreting raw dword arrays.

output_base.description: Canonical deterministic output-allocation address, or null when the document has no cases.

command_base.description: Canonical deterministic command-allocation address, or null when the document has no cases.

spm.description: Independent SPM request/response cases: every event at each block_index, then, for each event, one request covering all instances when instance_count is greater than one.

spm_dump.$comment: Event references, allocation roles, offsets, reference targets, and cross-field size relationships require semantic validation beyond JSON Schema.

interval.description: Advertised sample-interval range in clock cycles for one sample mode.

spm_configurations_dump.description: SPM configurations advertised for one registered agent topology.

format_version.description: Linear packet-dump format version for compatibility checks.

gfx.description: GPU architecture name used to register the agent.

topology.description: Relative path of the agent and IP-discovery fixture document for this architecture.
